protocol.rounds: Per-horizon initial TRAIN/VAL best_iteration + 1; no early stopping on refit.
protocol.features: Initial TPE subsets frozen; Pearson screening is never repeated.
protocol.scalers: Refit on each fold training histories and targets only.
protocol.primary_metric: Arithmetic mean of 60 horizon RMSEs, kW, daylight target mask.
protocol.prediction_variant: Raw inverse-scaled forecasts, matching the TPE objective.
protocol.fold_summary: Equal-fold mean of mean-horizon RMSE; pooled RMSE reported separately.

bootstrap.method: Paired moving calendar-day block bootstrap within each fold
bootstrap.unit: All horizons at an origin remain paired; missing days retained on calendar grid.
bootstrap.statistic: Recompute each horizon RMSE, then mean horizons and equal-weight folds.
bootstrap.multiplicity: Holm across three primary comparisons per declared endpoint; secondary exploratory.

benchmark.scope: Isolated full fixed-round TRAIN+VAL refits; batch-one 60-step inference.

protocol.disclosure: Initial partial VAL results were viewed before this protocol. No new TEST results used.

scope: Recorded tables and figures; full models/predictions remain in the local archive.
